headline.en: Configure Private AI Agent for Business

scenario.zh: 某零售连锁店需要自动化处理客户退货申请,要求数据不离开公司服务器
scenario.en: A retail chain needs to automate customer return requests while keeping data on company servers

output.zh: 代理部署在公司数据中心,客户数据完全私密,符合金融级安全要求
output.en: Agent deployed in company data center, customer data fully private, meets financial-grade security

output.zh: 代理在云端运行但连接本地数据库,处理速度更快但需配置VPN通道
output.en: Agent runs in cloud but connects to local database, faster processing but requires VPN tunnel

instruction.zh: 定义代理如何处理退货请求
instruction.en: Define how agent handles return requests

output.zh: 工作流:验证订单→政策检查→决策→通知,平均处理时长约2分钟
output.en: Workflow: verify→check policy→decide→notify, average handling around 2 minutes

output.zh: 增加照片审核和库存确认步骤,准确度更高但处理时长约4分钟
output.en: Added photo review and inventory check, higher accuracy but handling around 4 minutes

instruction.zh: 用100个历史案例测试两个配置
instruction.en: Test both configs with 100 historical cases

output.zh: 处理速度较快,客户满意度良好,少数复杂案例需人工介入
output.en: Faster processing, good customer satisfaction, few complex cases need manual review

output.zh: 准确度明显更高,退货纠纷大幅减少,但高峰期可能出现积压
output.en: Noticeably higher accuracy, disputes reduced significantly, but may backlog during peak hours

instruction.en: Choose final config and go live

output.zh: 代理开始处理实际退货请求,团队可监控面板查看处理状态和异常提醒
output.en: Agent handles real return requests, team monitors dashboard for status and alerts

output.zh: 代理以高准确模式运行,系统自动在高峰时段增加处理容量
output.en: Agent runs in high-accuracy mode, system auto-scales capacity during peak periods

takeaway.zh: 企业可在本地部署开源Hermes代理,定制工作流程并保持数据完全私密
takeaway.en: Businesses can deploy open-source Hermes agents locally with custom workflows and full data privacy

initial.zh: 处理客户退货:验证订单→检查退货政策→批准或拒绝→通知客户
initial.en: Handle customer returns: verify order→check policy→approve/reject→notify customer
